title: LP Building Solutions Expands LP SmartSide Trim & Siding Distribution Network, Bringing Full Portfolio to Customers Nationwide
summary: LP Building Solutions (LP), a leading manufacturer of high-performance building products, today announced a new distribution strategy for its LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding portfolio that will expand customer access to the full product line across the United States. The strategy brings together a select group of leading distribution partners that have committed to carrying LP's complete SmartSide® portfolio and supporting its continued growth in the market.
body_markdown:
**NASHVILLE, Tenn. (Sept. 29, 2026)** –[LP Building Solutions](https://lpcorp.com/) (LP), a leading manufacturer of high-performance building products, today announced a new distribution strategy for its LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding portfolio that will expand customer access to the full product line across the United States. The strategy brings together a select group of leading distribution partners that have committed to carrying LP's complete SmartSide® portfolio and supporting its continued growth in the market.


Under the new model, Specialty Building Products will provide nationwide coverage for professional dealers, one-step distributors, and retail customers, while other distribution partners will provide coverage in designated regions. These partners include BlueLinx, Coastal Forest Products, Forest Products Supply Co., J.M. Thomas Forest Products, Minot Builders Supply, Palmer-Donavin, Sherwood Lumber Company, Taiga Building Products, Wausau Supply Co., Weyerhaeuser, and WS Building Materials. Several of these distributors are existing LP partners expanding their SmartSide offerings, while others will join LP's siding distribution network for the first time.


Participating distributors will carry the full LP SmartSide portfolio, including ExpertFinish® and Naturals Collection™ products, and transition away from competing siding products.


The simplified model is designed to expand product availability, strengthen distributor focus on LP's siding offerings, and create a more consistent customer experience across markets.


The distributors selected as part of the strategy share LP's focus on long-term growth, customer service, and market development. They bring dedicated sales organizations, sophisticated logistics networks, broad product availability, and a proven ability to deliver products accurately, completely, and on time while supporting customer growth in local markets.


"Customers want dependable access to products and exceptional service from partners they know and trust," said LP Chief Commercial Officer Craig Sichling. "By committing to the full SmartSide portfolio, these distributors will help expand product availability, strengthen customer support, and bring the LP brand to more customers than ever before. This strategy positions us to continue growing SmartSide Trim & Siding while making it easier for customers to access the products they need."


LP® Oriented Strand Board, LP® Structural Solutions, and offsite construction product lines will continue to be available through the vast majority of existing distributors.


For more information, visit[LPCorp.com](https://lpcorp.com/) .


**About LP Building Solutions**


As a leader in high-performance building solutions, Louisiana-Pacific Corporation (LP Building Solutions, NYSE: LPX) manufactures engineered wood products that meet the demands of builders, remodelers, and homeowners worldwide. LP’s extensive portfolio of innovative and dependable products includes siding (LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding, LP BuilderSeries® Lap Siding, and LP® Outdoor Building Solutions®), LP® Structural Solutions (LP® FlameBlock® Fire-Rated Sheathing, LP BurnGuard® FRT OSB, LP WeatherLogic® Air & Water Barrier, LP® TechShield® Radiant Barrier Sheathing, LP Legacy® Premium Sub-Flooring, and LP® TopNotch® 350 Durable Sub-Flooring), and LP® Oriented Strand Board. In addition to product solutions, LP provides industry-leading customer service and warranties. Since its founding in 1972, LP has been Building a Better World™ by helping customers construct beautiful, durable homes while shareholders build lasting value. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, LP operates more than 20 manufacturing facilities across North and South America. For more information, visit LPCorp.com.
